name: Peace Valley Nature Center Summer Camp
description_short: Nature day camp on the 750 acres of meadow, forest and streams at Peace Valley Nature Center in Bucks County. Mornings are guided hikes and habitat exploration with a naturalist, afternoons are choice activities like water play, crafts and shelter building; Explorers (finished K to 2) and Rangers (finished 3 to 6) run in separate groups. Families need a nature center membership to enroll.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel by May 1 for a full refund less a $50 fee; by June 1 for a 50% refund; no refunds after June 1, for mid-week withdrawals or behavior dismissals.
notes: Full day 9:30 to 3:00 for sessions 1 to 7; sessions 8 and 9 are half day Wilderness Survival, 9:30 to 12:00, $150. Enrollment requires a Family membership ($50) or higher; the posted rate is the only rate and there are no discounts. The camp director says to ask about options if cost is a barrier. Separate Fledgling Flock program for ages 3 to 5 with a caregiver, 10:00 to 12:00, $95 a session. 2027 registration opens in mid January; 2027 dates and rates not yet posted.
